name: @w6w-apps/uscreen
description: Manage Uscreen customers, subscriptions and product access, groups, invoices, offers, content visibility and view analytics.

w6w.longDescription: Uscreen is a video membership and OTT platform: a creator sells subscriptions, rentals and one-off purchases of videos, collections and live events from a branded storefront and apps. This app drives the Publisher API from a workflow: invite and update customers, grant or revoke product access, start and cancel subscriptions, manage group (team) seats, read invoices and offers, publish, unpublish or schedule content, mint single-sign-on links, and pull view analytics.
